description: Land Title Settlement Department - Thubana, Ridigama D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420060
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including details of land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land registration and title settlement processes, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
